adjudication.rationale: The diff adds `app/views/embed/loading.html.erb` with a `setTimeout(function() { document.location.reload(); }, 30000);` that will keep reloading every 30s whenever the embed remains in the "loading" state. There is no attempt counter, backoff, or stop condition in the view, so if `TopicEmbed.topic_id_for_embed` never becomes available (e.g., job fails or invalid URL), the client will poll indefinitely. This is a real, diff-grounded concern (potential unnecessary load / bad UX), but it’s not strictly a correctness break given the current implementation intends to poll while waiting.
